{{Use British English|date=January 2018}}
'''David Preiss''' FRS (born 21 January 1947) is a Czech and British mathematician, specializing in [[mathematical analysis]]. 
He is a [[professor]] of [[mathematics]] at the [[University of Warwick]]<ref>[http://www2.warwick.ac.uk/fac/sci/maths/people/ Mathematics Staff and Postgraduates], University of Warwick  Institute of Mathematics. Revised 2 March 2012. Retrieved 26 October 2015.</ref> 

Preiss is a recipient of the [[Ostrowski Prize]] (2011)
and the winner of the 2008 [[London Mathematical Society]] [[Pólya Prize (LMS)|Pólya Prize]]<ref>{{cite web|title=List of LMS prize winners |publisher=[[London Mathematical Society]] |url=http://www.lms.ac.uk/content/list-lms-prize-winners|accessdate=26 October 2015}}</ref> for his 1987 result on ''Geometry of Measures'', where he solved the remaining problem in the geometric theoretic structure of sets and [[measure (mathematics)|measures]] in [[Euclidean space]].<ref>[https://www.lms.ac.uk/news-entry/20052011-1109/press-releases#2008 London Mathematical Society Prizes 2008], London Mathematical Society, Media release, 4 July 2008. Retrieved 26 October 2015.</ref>
He was an invited speaker at the ICM 1990 in Kyoto.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.mathunion.org/icm-plenary-and-invited-speakers?combine=preiss|title=ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers|publisher=International Mathematical Union|access-date=2024-05-17}}</ref>
He is a [[Fellow of the Royal Society]] (2004)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://royalsociety.org/people/david-preiss-12118/|title=Professor David Preiss FRS|work=Fellows directory|publisher=Royal Society|access-date=2024-05-17}}</ref> and a Foreign Fellow of the [[Learned Society of the Czech Republic]] (2003).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.learned.cz/cz/clenove-ucene-spolecnosti/zahranicni-clenove-ucene-spolecnosti/preiss-david.html|title=Preiss David|publisher=Learned Society of the Czech Republic|language=Czech|access-date=2024-05-17}}</ref>

He is associate editor of the mathematical journal ''[[Real Analysis Exchange]]''.<ref>[http://msupress.org/journals/raex/edboard/?id=50-214-B Editorial Board] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190906040438/http://msupress.org/journals/raex/edboard/?id=50-214-B |date=6 September 2019 }}, ''Real Analysis Exchange''. Retrieved 26 October 2015.</ref>
